ranking.name: Water running off the surface
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water running off the surface in Central Africa changed by +0.0186 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval +0.0101 to +0.0273), which is statistically significant (p < 0.001). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is an increase of about 0.0459 mm/day.

cautions: The confidence interval is wide compared with the trend, so the size of the change is uncertain.
ranking.name: Water leaving the land (evapotranspiration)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water leaving the land (evapotranspiration) in Central Africa changed by +0.138 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval +0.065 to +0.212), which is statistically significant (p < 0.001). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is an increase of about 0.340 mm/day.
